name: NASA Procedural Requirements 8735.2C — Management of Government Property in the Possession of Contractors
description: Property management, traceability, and disposition controls applicable to manufacturing and contractor-held hardware.

rules.title: Serialized item traceability
rules.text: Each serialized property item shall be traceable by unique identifier from receipt through disposition, with custody transfers recorded.

rules.title: Material certification retention
rules.text: Certifications of conformance for material lots shall be retained and associated with every consumed quantity until disposition of the finished item.

rules.title: Nonconforming property segregation
rules.text: Nonconforming property shall be identified, segregated where practicable, and dispositioned by authorized personnel before further processing.
